I have trekked the Sham Valley for 6 days. The company has arranged everything very quickly, everything was well organized and punctual .  There were no hidden fees or surprises, everything exactly as they told me. There was a part of the trek I wanted to skip and without any questioning they made the change for me for which I am very grateful. My guide Stanzin was absolutely amazing, her English was excellent, her knowledge of the culture, sauna and flora was also very good. She was so very kind and helpful. Even after a tired hike she did whatever I wanted to do without any hesitation. She knows the route and the home stays very well. I highly recommend this agency and I hope to take another trek with them.

On a recent adventure to northern India Leh Ladakh I have the pleasure of dealing with a remarkable company who I’d like to recommend highly.
From the get go my emails were responded with efficient speed, accuracy, enthusiasm & useful tips and pointers.
Tsogail of Ladakhi Women’s Travel Company made a personalised tour catering to my every wish all the while ensuring that my safety was top of the list, by this I mean the sensible acclimatisation to high altitude.
Tsogail made sure that all the arrangements were confirmed.
The most wonderful guide Tenzin Sunshine accompanied me on my tour. Her knowledge of the area, historical sites and local interesting facts was well received. Nothing was ever too much to ask. When I requested momos for dinner Tenzin arrangement that we spent the evening together learning how to make momos from scratch, a wonderful experience.
Our polite driver Phuntsog (spelling) was cautious and careful, happy to stop for photo moments whenever I asked.
The overall experience with LWTC was excellent, I would certainly book through them again and look forward to trekking with Tenzin Sunshine one day.

We did the 5-day Markha Valley trek in early June 2022. I highly recommend hiring LWTC due to their professionalism, experience, and a chance to walk through this beautiful land while learning from Ladakhi women!   Thinlas was super responsive and clear in her emails leading up to the trek, offering advice  on packing and on which trek to choose.  They were accommodating with any requests we had, like wanting to visit a monestary on our way back to Leh. Our guide, Rigzin, was particularly amazing with her attitude and helpfulness on the trek. She made all of the logistics of trekking easy, from packed lunches to communicating with locals along the way. Rigzin generously shared her knowledge of Ladakhi culture, plants and animals, and literally held my hand when we were walking on some narrow paths on the last day. The homestays were gorgeous, with tea, dinner, snd breakfast each day— and we largely had the homestays to ourselves due to trekking in the off season. They are also well-priced compared to some other trekking companies with similar services. Thank you, LWTC!

Thanks to our wonderful guides Thinlas and Lamu we had the best experience trekking in the Markha Valley for 8 days! We were very much taken care of, they made sure even our special requests like vegan and gluten-free meals are followed, we were able to spot a lot of wildlife, learn about the culture and Buddhism, and interact with locals. The landscape was stunning and even though the weather and our physical abilities were challenging from time to time, Thinlas and Lamu made sure it’s all doable and took very good care of us and our safety. We’ll be back!! Julley 💛

I did a week of trekking with the Ladakhi Women Travel Company and absolutely loved all of it! Thinlas, the founder, was my guide and she was not only a professional in the mountains, but also provided a unique and authentic experience for us. Translating in the homestays, taking us up paths that only she knows, picking up the garbage along the way, and telling about her culture. She even prepared me to do other trekkings after that on my own.

If you want to have an authentic and sustainable experience trekking and discovering the culture of Ladakh, book with this company!

I had such a wonderful experience with Ladakhi Women’s Travel Company — it was everything I had hoped for and more. As a solo woman traveler, I was a little nervous at first, but from the moment I landed, everything felt smooth, safe, and thoughtfully handled.

A big thank you to Tsogyail for managing all the logistics — from airport pickup to monastery visits, Stok la trek, and final drop — everything was seamless.

And I can’t say enough about Rigzin, my guide — so kind, calm, and encouraging. When I struggled with my backpack, she even offered to carry my water bottle — a small gesture that meant a lot. We saw beautiful views, wildlife, and shared stories that made the journey feel even more special.

Staying at the Rumbak Homestay was another highlight. It gave me a glimpse into Ladakhi life, and Rigzin helped me connect with the host family in such a warm and easy way.

Every person I met — including the lovely taxi drivers — made me feel welcome and at ease. If you're considering a trip to Ladakh, especially as a solo woman, I can’t recommend this team enough. It's not just about travel — it’s about connection, empowerment, and unforgettable memories.

Will definitely be back.

Siddhi
Travelled : June 2025

My friend P and I and had a phenomenal experience with LWTC. Thinlas (the founder of LWTC I believe) was very responsive and helpful via email in the weeks and even months leading upto our trek. We did the Markha Valley trek with Rigzin as our guide and were blown away. Not only was the trek incredibly beautiful, but Rigzin time and time again made so much happen behind the scenes so that it was all very easy for us (coordinating with the home stays, for example). She was calm and collected throughout and very caring and generous with her energy, even carrying my pack at one point during an ascent when the altitude sickness made it difficult to breathe. We would 100% do another trek with LWTC, and hopefully with Rigzin! So pleased with the safety and ease which LWTC provided. The Markha Valley trek is also a beautiful blend of natural wonder and cultural exposure as we experienced tiny Ladakhi villages in the off-season. Thank you Rigzin, Thinlas, and LWTC!

A fully women-run telling agency. They conduct hikes starting at 3 days that range from easy to hard. Their guides are very knowledgeable of the culture, ecology and folklore. They are very professional, prompt and reliable. And your payment for homes goes to support local Ladakhi women.
